description.message: Recognize numeric fields on sites you enable for IMELayoutRouter V1 or V2.

unsupported.message: Open an HTTP or HTTPS page to choose a site.

failure.message: Could not change the site setting. Open the extension again on the original site and retry.

sourceChanged.message: The original tab changed or closed. Open the extension again on the site you want to configure.

privacy.message: Only the field type is sent to the Windows app. Typed characters and verification codes are never read.
